name: MEVbot
fix_description: Function 0xf6ebebbb has no access control check. The contract has owner/trader/operator role system (setOwner, addTrader, addOperators) but this critical function does not verify msg.sender against any role. Fix: add require(traders[msg.sender] || msg.sender == owner) check.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is extremely short and the exploit path is basically repeated flash loans against a vulnerable contract with no complex callback logic, routing, or multi-protocol interaction implemented in the test. An auditor would mainly need to identify that the target can be drained via borrowed USDT sent directly to it, which fits a straightforward single-pattern exploit rather than deep protocol reasoning.
